description: Pull specific values out of a web page with CSS selectors. Pass selectors as {key: "css"}. Suffix a selector with @attr for an attribute and with [] for every match, so "a.item[]@href" returns an array of links. href, src, data-src and poster values are resolved to absolute URLs. Static HTML only: nothing is executed, and a selector that matches nothing returns null or an empty array rather than an error. Network: needs the target website. Optional packages: cheerio. Without them this tool reports what is missing instead of guessing.

selectors.description: Map of output key to CSS selector.

url.description: Page URL to scrape. Fetching is SSRF-guarded.

name: extract_web
